notMapped.reason: The data files do not record whether E1 or eBR was asked first, so the two order arms cannot be separated. Each participant is loaded once per study with arm = condition = the study id ('study1', 'study2', 'study3').

exclusions: Paper p. 7: trials with E1 equal to BR are excluded (also dropped again by evaluation.evaluate), and trials whose signed update lies beyond 3 x IQR of the quartiles within their valence (negative/neutral/positive) x direction (upwards/downwards) cell are removed as outliers. load() applies this at trial level, which reproduces the paper's neutral-trial counts and means; evaluation.evaluate's own participant-level outlier rule then runs on top.
